title: Notion MCP notion-query-database-view returns a tool error saying to use notion-query-data-sources
symptoms: tool error naming notion-query-data-sources as the replacement
saved view queries that worked with a cached tool list now fail
cause: notion-query-database-view was removed from tool lists on 2026-08-13 and calls to it stopped working on 2026-09-29.
fix: Call notion-query-data-sources with data.mode set to view and the same view_url.
